focus: 1952 부산정치파동에서 서민호 사건, 의원 체포, 경찰 강제등원, 발췌개헌 표결을 단일 대통령 행위가 아니라 사법·군·경찰·입법 action chain으로 분리

documents.title: Memorandum of Conversation, Muccio/Lightner with President Rhee
documents.provenance: US Department of State FRUS 1952-1954 Korea XV/1, document 135
findings: Rhee said the Defense Minister had urged martial law in Tongnae and two neighboring districts; Rhee approved and asked that Pusan itself be included.
Rhee said he could not trust the Chief Justice, apparently referring to the So Min-ho release, and said he would have to take action against him.
FRUS editorial note records So Min-ho as an independent opposition assemblyman, his April 24 shooting case, May 14 Assembly-backed release under Constitution Article 49, and trial beginning May 22.

documents.title: FRUS Editorial Note on proclamation and first arrests
documents.provenance: US Department of State FRUS 1952-1954 Korea XV/1, document 138; cites telegram 1160, 1952-05-26
findings: Martial law was proclaimed at midnight May 24 in Pusan and 22 counties.
Immediately beforehand Rhee appointed Yi Pom Suk Home Minister, Hong Pom-Hi Vice Home Minister, and Yun-Kyong Chief of National Police.
So Min-ho was arrested early May 25; military police then attempted arrests of opposition assemblymen and arrested four legislators.
The Embassy interpreted the pattern as an attempt to prevent an Assembly quorum, but this remains a contemporaneous US assessment rather than a Korean direct-order document.

documents.title: Report of the United Nations Commission for the Unification and Rehabilitation of Korea, A/2187
documents.access_status: search-index text accessible; direct PDF fetch returned 403 in this run
findings: Indexed original text states that after martial law on May 25 So Min-ho was arrested by ROK military police and transferred to court martial.
The report reproduces a Martial Law Commander public notice giving the command's stated legal/military rationale for transferring So to court martial.
This creates a primary UN-recorded bridge from individual criminal case to martial-law jurisdiction, but does not by itself prove who ordered the arrest.

documents.title: Telegram 1200, Lightner to Department of State
documents.provenance: US Department of State FRUS 1952-1954 Korea XV/1, document 149
findings: The US formally asked that martial law be lifted immediately in Pusan because EUSAK judged it unnecessary as a military necessity.
Rhee replied that martial law would be lifted 'shortly' but defended arrests as action against an internal conspiracy.

Lightner challenged the coincidence that those arrested were opposition assemblymen; Rhee denied that voting against amendments was the arrest ground and claimed conspiracy evidence. This conflicting attribution must be preserved.

documents.title: FRUS Editorial Note on forced attendance and constitutional amendment
documents.provenance: US Department of State FRUS 1952-1954 Korea XV/1, document 206; cites UN A/2187 pp.9-11
findings: On July 2 the ROK Government announced absent assemblymen would be 'guided and escorted' by police to the Assembly Hall.
Police rounded up legislators; even seven assemblymen on trial in the Communist conspiracy case were brought to participate.
On July 4, 166 members were present and the substance of the amendment was adopted 163-0 with 3 abstentions.
On July 15 the Assembly passed implementing legislation. Exact law title/number and identities of the three abstainers remain open.

documents.title: National Library of Korea NARA RG84 Seoul Embassy Classified General Records 1952-63 finding aid
documents.provenance: National Library of Korea / NARA RG84
findings: The indexed record group places Law No.69, State Council Public Notice No.37, June 3 Martial Law Command public notice/release, Proclamations 2-6, Public Peace Information 11-12, and a Yong-Nam Martial Law Command letter to the US Ambassador in the same archival sequence.
This is a finding aid, not the underlying documents; it narrows exact primary-document targets without upgrading their contents to verified.

adversarial_checks.claim: 서민호 체포는 개헌 반대 표결 때문에 이루어졌다
adversarial_checks.reason: 미측은 야당 의원만 체포되는 패턴을 문제삼았으나 이승만은 5/30 이를 부인하고 공산 음모 증거를 주장했다. 서민호 본인은 별도의 살인 사건과 계엄사령부 공고상 군사재판 이관 사유가 존재한다.

adversarial_checks.claim: 계엄은 순수 군사 필요 때문에 선포됐다
adversarial_checks.reason: 5/30 미국 공식 전달문은 EUSAK 판단상 부산 계엄이 군사적 필요가 아니라고 명시했다.
공식 FRUS/UN 계열은 7/2부터 경찰이 불참 의원을 강제등원시켜 정족수를 확보했다고 기록한다. 개별 의원별 강압 정도와 3명 기권 신원은 추가 원문 필요.
정부 발표와 경찰 집행은 확인되나 이범석 개인 결재·지시문은 아직 확보되지 않았다.
UNCURK가 계엄사령관 공고를 수록하지만 이번 접근본에서 서명·명령서 번호까지 직접 확인하지 못했다.

부산 계엄의 필요성: 이승만/국방부 계엄 추진 진술 + EUSAK의 군사적 불필요 판단 + UNCURK 해제 권고
